facts.text: Evan encouraged Sam to stay positive and keep going during their conversation on 8 October 2023.

evidence.quote: Hey Sam, glad I can be here for you! Progress is key, so keep pushing on and stay positive. You got this!
Go get 'em! Believe in your abilities and you'll reach your goals. Stay motivated!

facts.text: Sam expressed gratitude towards Evan for his support and mentioned that Evan's words gave him a boost.

evidence.quote: Thanks Evan! Your words gave me a boost. I'm staying motivated and believing in myself.

facts.text: Evan reminded Sam to be patient with himself and emphasized the importance of staying upbeat.

evidence.quote: You're welcome, Sam! It takes time, so be patient with yourself. Your health matters, and I believe in you. Keep going and stay upbeat. You got this!
